purpose: Compare per-observable Qiskit LightCone reduction followed by Aer with LazyQC's structure-keyed batch planning, charging all reduction, lowering, deduplication and execution costs.
simulator: Qiskit Aer statevector, GPU, double precision; reduced circuits submitted as one job per method call
lazyqc_backend: Single-thread Qulacs; the depth-four cones remain below the GPU placement threshold
timing_scope: Qiskit circuit and DAG are prebuilt. Every repetition includes LightCone passes, compaction, circuit lowering and expectation setup, optional deduplication, and execution. LazyQC includes plan_all and collect.
validation: Every timed method output against LazyQC's Qulacs expectations, tolerance 1e-9
scope: Z on every wire of the hardware-efficient local family; not a claim about other observables or transpilation pipelines
